proof_scope: Live progressive reveal in Surf's real Chrome plus native export: manual next/prev builds over first/middle/last slides, group and diagram node/edge reveals with no orphan edges, On Click default plus With/After Previous timing with real delays, distinct mid-frame effects, GUI authoring with preview/apply/undo over canonical CAS persistence, reduced-motion override, inert hidden future items, typing-key protection, and structural p:timing verification of the exported PPTX with a static full-content PDF

claims.proves: Builds advance and reverse per keyboard/Home/End/rapid input including cancel of in-flight and delayed chains; revisit restores completed builds; a with-previous row shares its predecessor's click and can add a second action to the same object; GUI edits persist only animation metadata through the CAS API and undo restores the source; stale/unknown-target/invalid-timing/invalid-phase writes are refused with no file change; hidden future items are inert; typing in panel inputs never advances slides; the 25 effect primitives are distinct catalog entries with wipe/zoom/fly/pulse proven distinct at paused mid-frames; exported PPTX carries p:timing with correct shape targets, click order, node types and durations, zero-build slides carry none, nested diagram targets are receipted as skipped, the emission differs from an animation-free emission only by p:timing, and the LibreOffice PDF shows full readable content
claims.does_not_prove: Microsoft PowerPoint or Google Slides slideshow PLAYBACK (structural XML and a LibreOffice PDF are not playback evidence), OS-level prefers-reduced-motion emulation, mid-frame verification of every one of the 25 effects, or visual approval of motion design
